capabilities: Edit notes simultaneously with live cursors
Sync shared folders between collaborators, including offline edits
Share relays with other users via share keys
Manage relay membership and kick users
extras: Freemium: free tier up to 3 users with no cloud storage, Hobby and Starter paid tiers. Plugin code is MIT licensed, but the login, permissions, and billing server code is proprietary, and even self-hosted setups use the hosted control plane for login. Support happens via Discord; kick users cannot be prevented from rejoining.
problem: Obsidian is a single-user app with no built-in way to edit notes together in real time or share folders with collaborators.

relations.evidence: We use a Conflict-Free Replicable Data Types (CRDTs) provided by the excellent yjs library.
The Relay Server is a fork of y-sweet and is MIT licensed.

summary: Real-time collaborative editing plugin that syncs shared folders between users using CRDTs, with live cursors and offline editing.
